description:
Bold mag wheels deliver that old-school BMX vibe while offering a durable, low-maintenance ride. Perfect for your neighborhood or the local park, the Torch gives you trick-friendly features and head-turning style for casual freestyle fun.
A sturdy one-piece crankset delivers smooth, reliable power for casual freestyle fun and neighborhood rides. Paired with a durable chainring and smooth-rolling bearings, this setup is built to handle everyday rides.
The premium BMX-style saddle offers a secure and comfortable ride, whether you're cruising the streets or trying tricks. Its durable, grippy texture helps you stay in control during every move.
The rugged steel frame is designed for BMX-inspired fun, giving riders durability and control for neighborhood tricks or maybe trying out a park session. Backed by Huffy’s iconic name and a limited lifetime frame warranty, this BMX-inspired ride is built to keep the fun going.
Front and rear alloy caliper brakes provide reliable stopping power, while textured grips keep your hands from slipping while you ride. This setup gives you confident control every time.

components.description: Reliable Braking Control: Front and rear alloy caliper brakes give you confident stopping power whenever you need it.
